______ is a document that shows that the person disclosed there in is entitled to the right of ocupancy.
certificate of occupancy

______ refers to land and all things attached to the land.
Real property
Real property refers to land and all things attached to the land.
______ is the terms of years and the interest retained by the leasor including the right to possession at the end of the term is called the reversion.
period granted
The period granted is the terms of years and the interest retained by the leasor including the right to possession at the end of the term is called the reversion.
______ is a right to use and occupy land in accordance with the provisions of the Land Use Act.
Right of occupancy
Right of occupancy is a right to use and occupy land in accordance with the provisions of the Land Use Act.
______ is a chose in action and is an interest that can be transferrable as provided in the Article of Association of the company.
share

power of attorney
